review: GD rejected the guides on all three PoCs. A delayed release and a changed solved-part trace are insufficient evidence of a meaningful puzzle role.
revision: Remove all three guides. Keep slide axes explicit for bent bars, using the existing design schema.
future_acceptance: Demonstrate a necessary change in object dependencies, available motion, or access to an obstructed route when removing a guide.
Do not justify a guide only by additional pointer travel, drag count, or retention after pins release.
Pin-held bars do not automatically require a guide. Evaluate a proposed guide after its pin contacts release.
Do not generalize to banning every guide on a pin-held bar: later obstruction or axis constraints can be meaningful, but require a witness.

reference_observation.evidence: Upper-left horizontal green bar and upper-center blue U have visible pin contacts without a visible clamp. Outer bent bars display clamps.
reference_observation.confidence: visual observation only; mechanical behavior unknown
